lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid posterior to the gill slits, primarily concentrated in the mid-flank region with a decreasing diameter gradient towards the dorsal surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a clear grid-like architecture across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge line is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance circular blobs, primarily located on the posterior portion of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense cluster of smaller high-luminance spots which transition into a randomized pattern relative to the ordered grid of the lateral flank.
